contract.precondition: currentCashDesk.oclIsUndefined() = false and currentCashDesk.IsOpened = true and if currentSale.oclIsUndefined() = true then true else currentSale.IsComplete = true endif
contract.postcondition: let newSale:Sale in newSale.oclIsNew() and Sale.allInstances()->includes(newSale) and newSale.IsComplete = false and newSale.IsReadytoPay = false and newSale.BelongedCashDesk = currentCashDesk and currentCashDesk.ContainedSales->includes(newSale) and self.CurrentSale = newSale and result = true
